Description: Server Components reduce client JS bundle and enable direct data access
Do: Keep components server-rendered unless they need interactivity
Don't: Add 'use client' to every file
Code Good:
export default async function Page() { const data = await getData(); return
{data}
}
Code Bad: 'use client'; export default function Page() { const [data] = useState(null); useEffect(() => fetch(...), []) }

Description: Pass server data down as props to client interactive islands
Do: Wrap interactive parts in small client components
Don't: Make entire pages client components
Code Bad: 'use client'; // entire page with one onClick

Description: Push client boundaries as deep as possible in the tree
Do: Isolate interactivity to small leaf components
Don't: Mark layout or page-level components as client
Code Bad: // page.tsx 'use client'; export default function Page() { }

Guideline: Avoid passing server-only code to client
Description: Serialization boundary means no functions or classes as props
Do: Pass serializable data (strings numbers objects)
Don't: Pass functions database clients or Node APIs as props

Description: App Router uses folders for routes with page.tsx as the entry
Do: Follow folder conventions: page layout loading error not-found
Don't: Create custom routing logic or manual route matching

Description: Parenthesized folders group routes without affecting URL
Do: Group by feature or section: (marketing) (dashboard)
Don't: (auth)

Guideline: Use parallel routes for complex layouts
Description: Show multiple pages simultaneously in the same layout
Do: Use @slots for dashboards multi-panel views
Don't: Manage multi-panel state manually in one component
Code Bad: One massive component switching between panels

Description: Intercept navigation to show content in modal overlay
Do: Use (.) (..) (...) conventions for photo/detail modals
Don't: Build custom modal routing with state management

Description: Layouts persist across navigations and preserve state
Do: Put navbars sidebars and shells in layout.tsx
Don't: Duplicate nav/sidebar in every page.tsx
Code Good: export default function Layout({ children }) { return <Shell>{children}</Shell> }

Description: Templates create new instance on each navigation
Do: Use template.tsx for entrance animations or per-page effects
Don't: Use template when you want persistent state
Code Good: // template.tsx - remounts on each nav export default function Template({ children }) { return <FadeIn>{children}</FadeIn> }
Code Bad: Using layout.tsx and trying to detect route changes for animation

Description: Async Server Components can fetch data directly
Do: Use async/await in server components with direct DB or API calls
Don't: Fetch in useEffect on client side for initial data
Code Good: async function Page() { const posts = await db.post.findMany(); return <PostList posts={posts} /> }

Description: Server Actions handle form submissions and mutations securely
Do: Define actions with 'use server' for forms and mutations
Don't: Build separate API routes for every form submission
Code Good: async function createPost(formData: FormData) { 'use server'; await db.post.create({...}) }

Description: Fetch where the data is consumed not at page level
Do: Let each component fetch its own data in parallel
Don't: Waterfall fetches by passing data through many layers
Code Good: async function UserAvatar() { const user = await getUser(); return <Avatar src={user.image} /> }
Code Bad: Page fetches user then passes to Layout then to Avatar

Guideline: Use loading.tsx for instant loading states
Description: loading.tsx creates automatic Suspense boundaries
Do: Add loading.tsx for skeleton UIs per route segment
Don't: Show blank page while data loads
Code Bad: No loading state - blank screen for 2 seconds

Description: Wrap slow components in Suspense for progressive rendering
Do: Suspense around individual data-heavy components
Don't: Wait for all data before rendering anything
Code Bad: await Promise.all([getChart(), getTable(), getStats()]) then render all

Description: Automatic optimization lazy loading and responsive sizing
Do: next/image with width height and alt
Don't: Raw img tags or unoptimized images

Description: Above-fold hero images should skip lazy loading
Do: Add priority prop to hero and banner images
Don't: Lazy load above-fold images

Description: Self-hosted fonts with automatic font-display swap
Do: next/font/google or next/font/local in layout
Don't: External font CDN links or @font-face in CSS
Code Good: import { Inter } from 'next/font/google'; const inter = Inter({ subsets: ['latin'] })

Guideline: Apply font to body via className
Description: Use the font's className on html or body element
Do: Apply font variable to root layout
Don't: Apply font to individual components

Description: Export metadata object or generateMetadata function
Do: Metadata export in page.tsx and layout.tsx
Don't: Manual head tags or next/head

Description: generateMetadata for pages with dynamic content
Do: Async generateMetadata with params
Don't: Static metadata on dynamic pages
Code Good: export async function generateMetadata({ params }) { const post = await getPost(params.id); return { title: post.title } }
Code Bad: export const metadata = { title: 'Post' } // same for all posts

Description: OG images for social sharing previews
Do: opengraph-image.tsx for dynamic OG images
Don't: Skip OG images or use static screenshots

Description: Next.js has Request Memoization Data Cache Full Route Cache and Router Cache
Do: Learn which cache applies where and how to opt out
Don't: Assume everything is always fresh or always cached

Description: ISR with time-based or on-demand revalidation
Do: revalidatePath or revalidateTag after mutations
Don't: Manual cache busting with timestamps or random params

Guideline: Use dynamic imports for heavy components
Description: Code-split large client components with next/dynamic
Do: Lazy load modals charts editors and heavy libraries
Don't: Import everything at the top level
Code Good: const Chart = dynamic(() => import('./Chart'), { ssr: false })

Description: Parallel data fetching prevents sequential loading
Do: Fetch data in parallel or colocate with Server Components
Don't: Sequential client-side fetches in useEffect chains
Code Bad: useEffect user then useEffect posts (depends on user)

Guideline: Use React cache for request dedup
Description: Deduplicate identical data fetches within a render
Do: Wrap fetch functions with React.cache
Don't: Fetch same data in multiple components redundantly
Code Good: const getUser = cache(async (id) => db.user.findUnique({ where: { id } }))

Description: error.tsx creates automatic error boundaries per route segment
Do: Add error.tsx with recovery UI and retry button
Don't: Let errors crash the entire page or show default error
Code Good: 'use client'; export default function Error({ error, reset }) { return <Button onClick={reset}>Retry</Button> }
Code Bad: No error boundary - white screen on failure

Description: Custom 404 pages per route segment
Do: Add not-found.tsx with helpful navigation back
Don't: Show generic error for missing resources
Code Good:
export default function NotFound() { return
Post not found. Browse all
}
Code Bad: throw new Error('Not found') // shows error.tsx instead

Description: Catches errors in root layout including layout-level failures
Do: Add app/global-error.tsx as last resort error boundary
Don't: Rely only on segment-level error.tsx
Code Good: // app/global-error.tsx 'use client'; export default function GlobalError({ reset }) { return <html><body>...</body></html> }

Description: Both are well-supported and tree-shakeable
Do: CSS Modules for scoped styles or Tailwind for utility-first
Don't: Runtime CSS-in-JS libraries in Server Components
Code Bad: import styled from 'styled-components' // breaks in RSC

Guideline: Use cn() utility for conditional classes
Description: Merge Tailwind classes cleanly with clsx + tailwind-merge
Do: cn() helper for component variants
Don't: String concatenation for conditional classes

Guideline: Use middleware for auth and redirects
Description: Middleware runs before every matched request
Do: Auth checks redirects geo-routing in middleware.ts
Don't: Heavy computation or database queries in middleware
Code Good: // middleware.ts - check auth token and redirect if missing
Code Bad: Database query in middleware for every request

Description: Route params and search params need proper typing
Do: Define typed params for dynamic routes
Don't: Use any or untyped params
Code Good: type Props = { params: Promise<{ slug: string }>; searchParams: Promise<{ q?: string }> }
Code Bad: export default function Page({ params }: any)

Description: Type-check metadata without losing inference
Do: satisfies Metadata for type safety
Don't: Untyped metadata objects
Code Good: export const metadata = { title: 'Home' } satisfies Metadata
Code Bad: export const metadata = { titel: 'Home' } // typo not caught

Description: app/api/*/route.ts for REST endpoints
Do: Export named HTTP method handlers (GET POST PUT DELETE)
Don't: Default exports or catch-all handlers
Code Good: export async function GET(request: Request) { return Response.json({ data }) }
Code Bad: export default function handler(req, res) { } // Pages Router style

Guideline: Prefer Server Actions over API routes
Description: Server Actions are simpler for mutations from your own UI
Do: Server Actions for form submissions and data mutations
Don't: API routes for every client-server interaction

Description: Server Actions are public HTTP endpoints
Do: Use zod or similar to validate all inputs
Don't: Trust client data without validation
Code Good: const parsed = schema.safeParse(formData); if (!parsed.success) return { error: 'Invalid' }
Code Bad: const title = formData.get('title'); await db.create({ title }) // no validation

Description: Server-only secrets vs public env vars
Do: NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix only for truly public values
Don't: Expose API keys or secrets with NEXT_PUBLIC_

Guideline: Use the children pattern for composition
Description: Pass children for flexible component composition
Do: Slot content via children and named slots
Don't: Prop drilling for every piece of content

Description: Show changes immediately before server confirmation
Do: useOptimistic for instant UI feedback on mutations
Don't: Wait for server response before updating UI
Code Bad: await createItem(); router.refresh() // user waits for round trip

Description: Pre-render dynamic routes at build time
Do: Generate params for known dynamic pages
Don't: Dynamic rendering for static content
Code Good: export async function generateStaticParams() { return posts.map(p => ({ slug: p.slug })) }
Code Bad: Every blog post rendered on demand

Description: Identify large dependencies in client bundles
Do: Run analyzer periodically to catch bundle bloat
Don't: Ship unaware of client bundle size

Description: Combine static shell with dynamic streaming holes
Do: Enable PPR for pages with both static and dynamic parts
Don't: Full dynamic rendering for mostly-static pages
Code Good: export const experimental_ppr = true; // static shell + Suspense for dynamic
Code Bad: Entire page is dynamic because one component needs fresh data

Description: Server Components render real HTML for screen readers
Do: Use proper heading hierarchy landmarks and ARIA
Don't: Div soup with click handlers instead of buttons
